Bounded delta audit of the cycle-20261001-3 window (T-151 closed 18:38Z, T-157 the operator question answered and closed 18:50Z, T-155 the second beacon captured via SRC-119 plus the folder-wide sweep test, T-156 created and blocked on an operator decision), run as Core seat saipen-cli-01 on 12e30059c509b4b340c72f9a953fc97b6881c237 / git-delta-v1:9ed2b72098853356560f77b38a84e531f3f789afa1c7c316fcee843930172d5d. Positive verification first, reproduced this run: tools/validate.py -> 'Validation complete. Agent is conformant. (24 warning(s))', 0 problems, after the core sweep linkage gate forced the META-IMPROVEMENT + WEAK-MODEL reasoning on T-156; saipen work reverify T-99 --run 'python -m pytest -q' -> WORK_REVERIFIED on the new tree; python -m pytest -q -> exit 0; ruff --select E4,E7,E9,F on the touched files -> 'All checks passed!'; the T-155 sweep goes red on a planted unregistered beacon and green without it; SRC-119 and T-157 journaled.

IMP-001 [P3] [PROTOCOL_VIOLATION] [reproduced] [ticket]
expected: the beacon-registration invariant shipped in T-155 keeps reporting the same thing after the repository's own sanctioned hygiene passes, so a correctly captured operator file cannot turn red just because the operator tidied the board and the journal
actual: the sweep's entire corpus is BEACON_REGISTRY -- .saipen/intake/active/*.md plus .saipen/BOARD.md plus .saipen/LOG.md -- and neither receipt names the beacon it captured. Measured this run: SRC-117 does not contain the string 'milestoned1.md', and SRC-119 does not contain 'YAZADAYU_born1.md' either (its 'YAZADAYU' hits are the operator's own prose about an entity by that name, not the path). That is structural, not an oversight: the intake grammar has no source-path field, which T-151 already established and recorded. So both beacons are registered by exactly one BOARD '- [x]' DONE row plus two or three LOG checkpoint lines, and nothing else. Meanwhile the canonical validator, in the same run that passes, emits two warnings that prescribe removing both: 'BOARD.md is 69 KB (soft cap ~16 KB), of which 67 KB is closed-ticket text -- scrub ## DONE at the next CLEAN' and '.saipen/LOG.md is 1954 lines / 615 KB, past the ~300 line / ~64 KB soft cap -- seal it into .saipen/logs/LOG-<NNN>.md at the next checkpoint'. .saipen/logs/ already exists and is outside the sweep's glob. Follow both recommendations and the sweep reports humbox/milestoned1.md and humbox/YAZADAYU_born1.md as unregistered operator material -- a false positive on the two files the protocol handled correctly, on a tree that is in fact clean. The defect is in the invariant written one hour ago in this same cycle, not in the receipts; it is reported here rather than quietly patched because the fix has a design choice in it.
evidence: python over .saipen/BOARD.md, .saipen/LOG.md and .saipen/intake/active/SRC-{117,119}.md: 'SRC-117 names milestoned1: False', 'SRC-119 names YAZADAYU_born1.md: False'; BOARD DONE rows naming the basenames = 1 each, BOARD open rows = 0 each; LOG lines = 3 and 2; pathlib.Path('.saipen/logs').exists() -> True and BEACON_REGISTRY globs only intake/active, BOARD.md and LOG.md; the two quoted warnings are in this run's tools/validate.py output. Second, smaller limit in the same function: HUMBOX.glob('*.md') is not recursive, so a beacon arriving in a subdirectory of humbox/ is invisible to the sweep.

VERDICT: one P3 finding, reproduced this run, and it is a self-inflicted one -- the invariant audited here was written in T-155 four minutes earlier in this same cycle, which is exactly the window an improve audit exists to cover. Nothing from the archived cycles duplicates it (cycle -2's IMP-001/IMP-002 were the uncaptured beacon, now T-155, and the uncommitted patch, now T-156 and blocked on the operator; cycle -3 predates the sweep entirely). Two limits stated rather than dressed as defects: the improve cycle's source_head is unchanged at 12e3005 across cycles -2 and -3 because the audited content is uncommitted working-tree state, so git-delta-v1, not source_head, is the real audit identity; and LEGACY_UNREGISTERED_BEACON keeps eleven pre-intake operator files named rather than captured, which is visible debt, not a solved problem. Bounded verdict only: this cycle's delta. T-146 stays BLOCKED OPTIONAL_STUDY_UNAVAILABLE on zero real independent peers and T-156 stays BLOCKED OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED; neither is movable by an agent.
